grok-2-1.summary: A short read reports the requested end instead of the actual byte end, falsely producing JournalUnterminated and hiding a later shrink. Merges grok-2-1 and fable-2-2.
grok-2-1.fix: Set TailWindow.size to from + bytes.length - bomBytes; remove the unused requested-length argument locally if needed. Pin newline-aligned EOF and BOM-relative size in Helpers.test.ts, retaining full-read torn-suffix size; pin the reconcile stat/read truncation race and post-write JournalWriteConflict in Journal.regressions.test.ts.

sol-2-1.summary: Structural patch encoding handles only bare schema classes, so nullable class unions and transformed class payloads reject valid partial patches.
sol-2-1.fix: Derive structural patch encoding through class-bearing unions and codec transformations, preserving checks and transformations. Validate with the original registered codec before persistence. Add nullable-class and transformed-class appendPatch regressions to Journal.test.ts that assert retained fields, decoded class identity, and two persisted records; retain rejection of invalid patches before writing.

fable-2-1.summary: An unforced TextEncoder rewrite raises UTF-8 length measurement auxiliary space from O(1) to Theta(n) per line/window.
fable-2-1.fix: Restore the oracle's in-place UTF-16 counting control flow and surrogate handling with required Effect String/Option substitutions; remove the encoder and avoid full-input temporary buffers. Retain the TextEncoder differential property and explicit surrogate cases in Line.test.ts, restoring any rewritten upstream assertion lines.

fable-2-3.summary: Both Line.test.ts and Envelope.test.ts reduce upstream pathological nesting from 200,000 to 20,000 without a diagnostic, law, or ruling forcing the reduction.
fable-2-3.fix: Restore 200_000 depth in Line.test.ts and Envelope.test.ts, along with the original deep-parse and frame-boundary assertions and unforced fixture/sequence changes. Preserve required schema JSON-codec substitutions and D15 cast removal rather than restoring native JSON operations or as unknown. Attribute any demonstrated codec/engine diagnostic before modifying the oracle input.
